description: The control on the collision windows: the fragment's f32 E against the f64 decodeOnly()'s K₀ and V₀ at each sample's point, rounded to f32, judged by the per-operand scale alone, max(|K₀|, 1) + max(|V₀|, 1), the form before colour_composition §6's conditioning term (RQ-623). Any f32 evaluation misses the exact value by about κ·eps beside a collision, on every backend (lavapipe compiles the fragment and the decode stage alike, so they agree bit for bit), so the per-operand form disagrees and the gate fails it.
